name: 35 mm camera
summary: A small, quiet camera that takes 36 frames of 24 x 36 mm on cinema film, so that the photographer can work by hand in the street.
how: Use a 28 to 50 mm lens and focus by scale, not through the finder.
Shoot at 1/125 to 1/500 s, from the hand.
Show the full frame; keep the 2:3 format.

origin.note: Leitz sells the Leica I, designed by Oskar Barnack.

adoptions.via: Henri Cartier-Bresson starts to photograph streets with a Leica.
Life magazine starts in 1936 and prints picture stories that photographers shoot with small, fast cameras.
Young photographers buy old 35 mm cameras and shoot colour negative and Tri-X film again.

sources.title: Ian Jeffrey, Photography: A Concise History (1981)
